let count: number = 3;
const name = "turtle";
let ok: boolean = count > 2 && name.length === 6;
let big: bigint = 10n ** 20n;
const sym = Symbol("id");
console.log(count, name, ok, big, typeof sym, sym.toString(), sym.description);
count += 2;
count -= 1;
count *= 3;
count /= 2;
count %= 4;
count **= 2;
console.log(count, 7 / 2, Math.trunc(7 / 2), 7 % 3, -7 % 3, 2 ** 10, 0.1 + 0.2);
let s = "a" + 1 + 2;
s += 3;
console.log(s, `x=${count}, y=${count * 2}`, 'single', "double \"q\"");
let x: number | null = null;
console.log(x ?? "default", x === null, x == undefined);
x = 5;
console.log(x ?? 0, x > 3 ? "big" : "small");
let i = 0;
i++;
++i;
i--;
console.log(i, i++ + ++i, i);
console.log(5 & 3, 5 | 3, 5 ^ 3, ~5, 1 << 4, -16 >> 2, -16 >>> 28);
console.log(!true, !!0, void 0, typeof undefined, typeof null, typeof 1, typeof "s", typeof {}, typeof [], typeof (() => 1));
let u: string | undefined;
u ??= "set";
let v = 0;
v ||= 10;
let w = 1;
w &&= 7;
console.log(u, v, w);
const nums = [1, 2, 3] as const;
const pair: [string, number] = ["a", 1];
console.log(nums, pair, nums.length, pair[0]);
var legacy = 1;
console.log(legacy, 1e21, 123456789012345680000, 1 / 3, -0, [-0], 0 / 0, 1 / 0);
console.log(Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, Number.EPSILON > 0, 0xff, 0o17, 0b101, 1_000_000);
